mainText: Good morning. Futures are mixed after Monday's selloff, with the S and P up two tenths of a percent, the Nasdaq up six tenths, and the Dow down three tenths. Monday, the S and P fell almost two percent after a new Commerce Department rule on advanced AI chip exports hit chip stocks. Nvidia reports earnings after the close today, and October retail sales are due at eight thirty. The ten year Treasury yield is 5.12 percent, little changed. In premarket movers, GreenPower is up 63 percent on a speculative surge, Aytu BioPharma is up 45 percent on a buyout offer, and Red Cat is down 30 percent after withdrawing guidance. Home Depot is down about two percent after in-line results, and Disney is up about one percent after an earnings beat and a dividend raise.
